The check record is EMPTY until the sensitivity editor checks the name against the four lists of 7.1 (politicians of any rank; notorious public figures; famous fictional politicians and civil servants; places and characters of children's fiction) by generic web searches, and signs it with date and checker (D9: no record may say a person checked what no person checked). `cleared` lists near-matches the satire lint reports (edit distance 1 or sound-alike against deny-people.txt or deny-fiction.txt) that the checker read and accepted, as {"similar": "<the listed name>", "reason": "..."}; a cleared near-match is no longer reported.
